answer: Networks deploy cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs to link agent identity to progressive staking. Each verified agent stands on a security knoll, broadcasting its cryptographic status like a beacon. To flood the validation pool, a Sybil swarm faces superlinear bonding curves where collateral requirements scale as an exponential capital exhaustion mechanism. Fake identities rapidly deplete liquidity across an ocean of economic commitments, making large-scale attacks infeasible.
